idf_component_register(
    SRCS "log_viewer.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    PRIV_REQUIRES storage esp_timer vfs
    # Generated by tools/gen_viewer.py; committed so the firmware build needs
    # neither node nor Python beyond ESP-IDF's own.
    EMBED_FILES "assets/datalogger.html"
)

# The page footer names the firmware version it was generated for: flag a
# version.txt bump that was not followed by a regeneration.
idf_build_get_property(kdl_project_ver PROJECT_VER)
file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/assets/datalogger.html" kdl_viewer_ver_line
     REGEX "^  kdl-viewer-fw: " LIMIT_COUNT 1)
string(REPLACE "  kdl-viewer-fw: " "" kdl_viewer_ver "${kdl_viewer_ver_line}")
if(NOT kdl_viewer_ver STREQUAL kdl_project_ver)
    message(WARNING "assets/datalogger.html was generated for firmware '${kdl_viewer_ver}', "
                    "project is '${kdl_project_ver}': run python3 tools/gen_viewer.py")
endif()
